items.title: Lax representation and constructive reduction of a twelve-component semi-discrete lattice system
items.author: Oleksiy O. Vakhnenko; Vyacheslav O. Vakhnenko
items.source_version: SIGMA21(2025),089; final2025-09-17; published2025-10-22; official native TeX
items.difficulty_reason: The author construction matches a nontrivial matrix-valued semi-discrete zero-curvature equation, derives a coupled prototype field system and uses recurrence conservation laws to perform a nonlinear twelve-field reduction. The full matrices, coefficient equations and reduction identities are retained. This is a research-level integrable-lattice construction, not an isolated conservation-law calculation or a simple special case.

primary.label: Author twelve-component system eqs6.1-6.14 and exact time/parameter assumptions

proof_spans.label: Complete author zero-curvature ansatz, primary coefficient equations, local conservation-law reduction and twelve-field substitution

contexts.label: Uncounted six-field reduction and main section heading
